supersedes: V19 版之同名檔（R-VF67：事故期間之產物一律重生，不採用）
selection: R-VS58 之選池序，**P0 為外層分割**（R-VF64 甲案）。池 621，取池首 10 —— 全為 P0（P0(a) 3 ／ P0(c) 7）。
signal_notation: R-1 v2：PROXI $Param$ = "值"；Input Test Data 為 NA
spec_reference_source: R-VF68：037 `Source Requirement ID` → 035 SYSRA `Basic Report` 之「來源需求項目 ID」。10/10 全解。

tcs.tc_title: Power Tailgate Alert is not displayed when CAN node 82 (PTGM) is "Absent"
tcs.test_item:
When the HMI receives the value Absent via signal, $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$, Then the HMI shall not display the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting in the Vehicle Settings menu.

(Absent partition; paired with seq 244, which covers the Present partition of the same node)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is powered and the HU has completed start-up
2. PROXI $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$ is set to "Absent"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU
2. Open the Vehicle Settings menu and wait until it is fully rendered
3. Read the Vehicle Settings menu and check whether the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting is listed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is displayed
3. The Power Tailgate Alert customer setting is not displayed
tcs.reasoning: P0(a) 實體致動：電動尾門之行程內可能有人；其警示設定之有無直接決定夾傷風險是否被提示。值域來源 **0-CLAUSE**（R-VF60）—— 條文逐字：「the value Absent via signal, $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$」。

tcs.tc_title: Blind Spot Alert is not displayed when Blind_Spot_Monitoring is "Absent"
tcs.test_item:
If $Blind_Spot_Monitoring$ = [Absent], the LTM or ETM shall not display the Blind Spot Alert customer setting.

(Absent partition; paired with seq 245 (Present) and distinct from seq 242, which reads Blindspot_Trailer_Detection)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is powered and the HU has completed start-up
2. PROXI $Blind_Spot_Monitoring$ is set to "Absent"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU
2. Open the Vehicle Settings menu and wait until it is fully rendered
3. Read the Vehicle Settings menu and check whether the Blind Spot Alert customer setting is listed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is displayed
3. The Blind Spot Alert customer setting is not displayed
tcs.reasoning: P0(c) safety：其開關決定盲點警示**是否發出**；設定項不顯示即駕駛無從確認該警示之啟閉狀態。值域來源 **0-CLAUSE**（R-VF60）—— 條文逐字：「$Blind_Spot_Monitoring$ = [Absent]」。

tcs.tc_title: Lane Sense Warning is not displayed when Lane_Assist is "Not Present"
tcs.test_item:
If $Lane_Assist$ = [Not Present] or [Lane Departure Warning], the LTM or ETM shall not display the Lane Sense Warning customer setting

(Not-Present partition, first of the two suppressing values; paired with seq 246, which covers the two displaying values)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is powered and the HU has completed start-up
2. PROXI $Lane_Assist$ is set to "Not Present"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU
2. Open the Vehicle Settings menu and wait until it is fully rendered
3. Read the Vehicle Settings menu and check whether the Lane Sense Warning customer setting is listed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is displayed
3. The Lane Sense Warning customer setting is not displayed
tcs.remarks: A-VF18 / DR-35: the source clause is internally inconsistent — its fourth sentence names Cornering Lights feature availability while its concluding sentence acts on the Lane Sense Warning customer setting. Per V23 4.2 the concluding sentence governs; the two are not reconciled here.
tcs.reasoning: P0(c) safety：其開關決定車道偏離警示**是否發出**。值域來源 **0-CLAUSE**（R-VF60）—— 條文逐字：「$Lane_Assist$ = [Not Present] or [Lane Departure Warning]」。

tcs.tc_title: Suspension Service Mode is not displayed when CAN node 27 (ASM / ASCM) is "Absent"
tcs.test_item:
HMI receives the value as "Absent" via signal, $CAN_Node_27(ASM / ASCM)$ Then HMI shall not display the Suspension Service Mode customer setting in the Vehicle Settings menu.

(Absent partition; paired with seq 247 (Present) of the same node)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is powered and the HU has completed start-up
2. PROXI $CAN_Node_27_ASM_ASCM$ is set to "Absent"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU
2. Open the Vehicle Settings menu and wait until it is fully rendered
3. Read the Vehicle Settings menu and check whether the Suspension Service Mode customer setting is listed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is displayed
3. The Suspension Service Mode customer setting is not displayed
tcs.reasoning: P0(a) 實體致動：維修模式之車身升降，作業者可能在車下；其設定之有無決定該模式能否被進入。值域來源 **0-CLAUSE**（R-VF60）—— 條文逐字：「the value as "Absent" via signal, $CAN_Node_27(ASM / ASCM)$」。

(Absent partition, trailer side; distinct from seq 239, which reads Blind_Spot_Monitoring)
tcs.pre_conditions:

2. PROXI $Blindspot_Trailer_Detection$ is set to "Absent"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU
2. Open the Vehicle Settings menu and wait until it is fully rendered

tcs.expected_result:

tcs.reasoning: P0(c) safety：其決定拖車情境下盲點偵測範圍**是否延伸**；未延伸即拖車側之盲點無警示。值域來源 **0-CLAUSE**（R-VF60）—— 條文逐字：「Blindspot_Trailer_Detection = [Absent]」。Blindspot_Trailer_Detection 之允許值域不在 PROXI 表內，步驟 3 之 ER 標 PENDING：DR-34（DR-34）。

tcs.tc_title: Power Tailgate Alert is displayed and can be modified when CAN node 82 (PTGM) is "Present"
tcs.test_item:
When the HMI receives the value Present via signal, $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$, Then the HMI shall display the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting in the Vehicle Settings menu and allow the customer to modify the setting

(Present partition; paired with seq 238 (Absent). Modifiability is asserted as well as presence)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is powered and the HU has completed start-up
2. PROXI $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$ is set to "Present"
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU
2. Open the Vehicle Settings menu and wait until it is fully rendered
3. Read the Vehicle Settings menu and check whether the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting is listed
4. Select the Power Tailgate Alert customer setting and change its value
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up
2. The Vehicle Settings menu is displayed
3. The Power Tailgate Alert customer setting is displayed
4. The Power Tailgate Alert customer setting accepts the change and shows its new value
tcs.reasoning: P0(a) 實體致動：電動尾門之行程內可能有人；其警示設定之有無直接決定夾傷風險是否被提示。值域來源 **0-CLAUSE**（R-VF60）—— 條文逐字：「the value  Present via signal, $CAN_Node_82_PTGM$」。
